# Merlin Intelligence

> Merlin Intelligence (`https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu`) is an open-source collective and research practice dedicated to quantitative macroeconomics, geoeconomic intelligence, and sovereign knowledge infrastructure (OWL/SKOS ontologies, spectral graph singularity detection, and governed Graph-RAG architectures).

## Co-Founders

- [Marion Schaeffer](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/team/marion-schaeffer.html): Co-founder · Knowledge Architecture & AI. Applied mathematician and AI researcher (PhD in Artificial Intelligence, cognitive science), specialist in Ontology Learning, formal knowledge representation (`OWL/RDFS/SKOS`), and explainable agentic systems (`olaf`).
- [François Oustry](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/team/francois-oustry.html): Co-founder · Decision Intelligence & Sovereign AI. Applied mathematician (ENSTA Paris, PhD DGA, Courant Institute NYU, INRIA), founder of Raise Partner and co-founder of Suzugia (acquired by AllianceBernstein), creator of `eigenmind`.

## Core Hubs

- [Global Macro Research — Equilibrium Portfolio Series](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/pages/macro-research.html): Decodes cross-asset macroeconomic regimes via a walk-forward meta-allocator (1-of-60 deterministic-yet-adaptive convex optimization agents over 12 liquid ETFs), Euler marginal risk decomposition, Shapley attribution, and formal OWL/SKOS causal ontologies.
- [The Signal Series](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/pages/signals.html): Geoeconomic and systemic stability briefings mapping supply-chain corridors, sovereign debt/energy architectures, and AI control theory before consensus forms.
- [Open-Source Sovereign AI Stack](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/pages/open-source.html): MIT-licensed engines including `eigenmind` (spectral graph & Lovász singularity detection), `olaf` (Ontology Learning Agentic Framework MCP server built on Oxigraph + Qdrant), and `CogMaps`.
- [Manifesto — Singularities, Cognitive Assets and Value Creation](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/pages/manifesto.html)
- [Founding Team](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/pages/team.html)

## Global Macro Research Publications

- [Patience Is Priced, Scarcity Is Scarce, and Beta Is Rationed](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/articles/macro-research-2026-11-06.html) (Equilibrium Portfolio Series · Part 2 · November 6, 2026): Analyzes why two-thirds of equilibrium capital sits in front-end Treasury bills (`SHV`), US dollars (`UUP`), and intermediate bonds (`IEF`) while two-thirds of Euler risk concentrates in physical scarcity (`DBC`, `XLE`) and defensive healthcare (`XLV`).
- [Tightening Bounds, Compressing Risk: The Portfolio's Shift to Liquidity, and the Macro Fractures Behind the Move](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/articles/macro-research-2026-10-14.html) (Macro Monitor · October 14, 2026): Documents the late-September walk-forward transition into a cautious allocator agent (`SHV` 31.1%, 2.67% annualized vol) mapped via a 2-hop OWL/SKOS macroeconomic ontology subgraph.
- [When a Portfolio Becomes a Market Barometer](https://www.merlin-intelligence.eu/articles/macro-research-2026-10-06.html) (Equilibrium Portfolio Series · Introduction · October 6, 2026): Foundational methodology paper establishing how a long-only cross-asset strategy engineered for Calmar ratio and drawdown containment (-6.5% 8Y MaxDD, 4.22 3Y Calmar) acts as an observable macroeconomic state variable.

## Open-Source Repositories

- [eigenmind](https://github.com/merlin-intelligence/eigenmind): Graph singularity detection via Laplacian spectral decomposition and bottleneck geometry (MIT License).
- [olaf](https://github.com/merlin-intelligence/olaf): Ontology Learning Agentic Framework MCP server for incremental OWL/RDFS ontology construction with Oxigraph and Qdrant (MIT License).
